question: If (sec θ-tan θ)/(sec θ+tan θ)=(1)/(7), θ lies in first quadrant, then the value of (cosec theta+cot² theta)/(cosec theta-cot² theta) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By Componendo and Dividendo: sec θ / tan θ = (7 + 1) / (7 − 1) = 8 / 6 = 4 / 3.

Since sec θ / tan θ = (1/cos θ) / (sin θ/cos θ) = 1/sin θ = cosec θ.

∴ cosec θ = 4/3 and cot² θ = cosec² θ − 1 = (4/3)² − 1 = 7/9.

Required value = (4/3 + 7/9) / (4/3 − 7/9) = (19/9) / (5/9) = 19/5.

**∴ The correct answer is 19/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (sec θ − tan θ) / (sec θ + tan θ) = 1/7

**Formula Used:** Componendo and Dividendo: If a/b = c/d, then (b+a)/(b-a) = (d+c)/(d-c). Also, cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/865866ff264c3a6811fffa8f3a52bb53dba77aaf7f22a8c3972a500a21000e26.png] 

⇒ (sec θ − tan θ) / (sec θ + tan θ) = 1/7

⇒ [(sec θ + tan θ) + (sec θ − tan θ)] / [(sec θ + tan θ) − (sec θ − tan θ)] = (7 + 1) / (7 − 1)

⇒ (2 sec θ) / (2 tan θ) = 8 / 6

⇒ (1/cos θ) × (cos θ/sin θ) = 4 / 3

⇒ 1/sin θ = cosec θ = 4 / 3

⇒ cot² θ = cosec² θ − 1 = (4/3)² − 1 = 16/9 − 1 = 7/9

⇒ Value = (cosec θ + cot² θ) / (cosec θ − cot² θ)

⇒ Value = (4/3 + 7/9) / (4/3 − 7/9)

⇒ Value = [(12 + 7) / 9] / [(12 − 7) / 9] = 19 / 5

**∴ The correct answer is 19/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Componendo and Dividendo Rule

If the ratio a/b = c/d, then (a + b) / (a − b) = (c + d) / (c − d). This is very useful in simplifying trigonometric fractions.

Trigonometric Identities

The three fundamental identities are: sin² θ + cos² θ = 1, sec² θ − tan² θ = 1, and cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1.

Quadrant Rule for Trigonometry

In the first quadrant (0 ° to 90 °), all trigonometric ratios (sin, cos, tan, cosec, sec, cot) are positive.</p
